title: Factor-Residual Statistical Arbitrage (Avellaneda & Lee)
holding_period: days (mean-reversion time filtered to under 30 days)
data_requirements: daily point-in-time equity prices and returns for a broad universe
daily trading volume (for the volume-time signal enhancement)
sector ETF price history and a stock-to-sector mapping
point-in-time market capitalisation for the $1bn universe screen

sources.citation: Avellaneda, M., & Lee, J.-H. Statistical Arbitrage in the U.S. Equities Market. Working paper, June 15 2009; published as Quantitative Finance 10(7), 761-782 (2010).
Avellaneda, M., & Lee, J.-H. (2010). Statistical arbitrage in the US equities market. Quantitative Finance, 10(7), 761-782. (Published version, not consulted.)
Khandani, A. E., & Lo, A. W. (2007). What Happened to the Quants in August 2007? (The unwinding theory this paper validates.)
